title: Minimum time to type
statementMd:
`keyboard` is a string of 26 distinct letters laid out on a single row. Your finger starts at index 0 and moving between indices costs the absolute difference. Return the total time to type `word`.

**Example:** `typing_time("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", "cba")` returns `4`.
hints: Map each letter to its index.
